cavity_depth = cavity_y_max - cavity_y_min  # 17.5

# Central boss

boss_center_y = 7.2
boss_center_z = 13.3

# Through hole / counterbore

cbore_diameter = 13.2
cbore_depth = 10.7

from build123d import *

outer_radius = 39.0
body_length = 40.0
shaft_radius = 12.0
shaft_length = 40.0
chamfer_size = 1.0

# Main body: X from 0 to 40, centered at X=20
body = Pos(0, body_length/2, 0) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(outer_radius, body_length)

# Shaft: X from 40 to 80, centered at X=60
shaft = Pos(0, body_length + shaft_length/2, 0) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(shaft_radius, shaft_length)

result = body + shaft

result = chamfer(top_face.edges(), chamfer_size)

bottom_face = result.faces().sort_by(Axis.Y)[0]
result = chamfer(bottom_face.edges(), chamfer_size)

# Chamfer shaft front edge (Y=80 face)
top_face = result.faces().sort_by(Axis.Y)[-1]
result = chamfer(top_face.edges(), chamfer_size)

part = result
part.name = "cylindrical_body_with_shaft"
export_step(part, "output.step")

plate_diameter = 80.0

boss2_diameter = 17.0
boss2_height = 14.7

top_height = 9.5
hole_diameter = 8.0

plate = Pos(0, 0, plate_thickness / 2) * Cylinder(plate_diameter / 2, plate_thickness)

    part = part - Pos(px, py, plate_thickness / 2) * Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, plate_thickness + 2)
